name: XWFlow Canvas
description: The flow canvas. It draws steps as cards wired output to input, with frames and sticky notes. Editable canvases support selecting, dragging, wheel and button zoom, fit, tidy up and a minimap; read-only canvases only fit and display.

views.description: Presentation for each node, keyed by node id.

readOnly.description: Read-only canvases cannot be dragged or zoomed.

tools.description: Show zoom, fit and tidy tools.

insets.description: Space the fit leaves for floating panels.

maxFitScale.description: Fit never enlarges past this scale.

height.description: Fixed height for embedded canvases; full-bleed canvases fill their parent.
